name: Reply to a price question
bodyMd:
{{#if contact.firstName}}Hello {{contact.firstName}},{{else}}Hello,{{/if}}

Thanks for asking, and it is a fair question. The honest answer is that it depends on scope: how many pages, whether you need online booking or a shop, the text and photos, and the languages. A one-page site and a full rebuild are very different projects.

Rather than guess, could we take 15 minutes on a call? I will ask a few questions and then send you a clear written quote.

Best regards,
